questions.question_text: Explain the process of photosynthesis in green plants with a labeled diagram showing the essential inputs and outputs.
questions.model_answer: Photosynthesis is the biological process by which green plants synthesize glucose using carbon dioxide and water in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll, releasing oxygen as a byproduct. Inputs: sunlight, CO2, water. Outputs: oxygen and glucose.
questions.diagram_criteria: Hand-drawn leaf diagram clearly labeling Sunlight, Carbon Dioxide (CO2), Water, and Oxygen with directional arrows.

key_points.description: Definition of photosynthesis as food-making process using carbon dioxide and water
Requirement of sunlight and chlorophyll pigment
Release of oxygen gas as a byproduct
